title: Concept: Mustache template error returned to a client
description: A Mustache template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the template and the offset, which shows the server-side rendering pipeline for the page.
applicability: Deployments that render a Mustache template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the template and the offset, which shows the server-side rendering pipeline for the page.
